name: Validate module code/interface/version/ruleset and active-state consumers

Independent MODULE_APPROVE_ARTIFACT capability approval before registration, binding extcodehash, declared interface, version, ruleset ID and module ID
Executable module always requires ACTIVE lifecycle, canonical registered ruleset, unchanged runtime bytecode and declared module identity/interface, and clear bound emergency state

Production ModuleExecutionGateway enforces MODULE_EXECUTE capability scoped by module ID and selector and resolves activeImplementation on every invocation without unsafe address fallback or native-value forwarding

Adversarial test coverage of missing artifact approval, mismatched version, unregistered ruleset, changed runtime bytecode, inactive/scheduled module dispatch, emergency activation and invocation restrictions
Deployment provenance and independent attestation procedure documented in docs/highcountry/R02.12-MODULE-ACTIVATION.md
